title: Drawer
overview: A panel that slides from an edge. Keeps more of the page visible than a centered modal.
apply_when: Filters, details, or a secondary form while the page stays in view.
not_when: A blocking decision that needs the page dimmed (modal), or a tiny confirm (popconfirm).

role.overview: A panel from an edge. More of the page stays visible than a centered modal.
role.not_when: A blocking decision that needs the page dimmed (modal).

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Slides from start, end, top, or bottom.

state.overview: The overlay is not shown. The trigger stays available.
state.apply_when: The page is the place they work.
state.not_when: The overlay is still in the tab order while hidden.

state.overview: The overlay is shown and owns the conversation.
state.apply_when: They must see or finish this layer.
state.not_when: Content behind stays fully interactive when this overlay must trap.

state.overview: Focus is inside the overlay. Must stay visible.
state.apply_when: Tab, open, or restoring after a nested popover.
state.not_when: Focus dumped on the document behind.

accessibility.overview: The drawer has a name AT can speak.
The focused control inside stays visible.
After close, focus returns to the trigger.

keyboard.overview: Escape dismisses when dismiss is allowed.
keyboard.not_when: Escape loses unsaved work with no confirm.

keyboard.overview: Tab moves through the drawer. Say whether the page behind stays in the order.
keyboard.not_when: Focus is lost behind the panel.
